task_description: Migrate Assura storage from local JSON/JSONL files to a single shared PostgreSQL database. Schema is defined ONCE as source of truth: Drizzle ORM (web) owns the schema and migrations; SQLAlchemy 2.0 (scraper) only MAPS to the Drizzle-created tables (no DDL, no migrations). Connection via DATABASE_URL. FEAT-001 establishes the shared schema, the Drizzle data layer, the full web migration, the audit-chain-preserving storage, web test rewrite, and Docker/seed infra. FEAT-002 maps SQLAlchemy to those tables and migrates the three scraper storage call sites. FEAT-002 depends on FEAT-001 (tables must exist first).
